title: Hunt for movers
subtitle: Look at real SPHEREx images of one field at a time and say what changes between epochs.
privacy: Votes are anonymous. Destello stores a random code in this browser, never a name or an account. A salted hash of the network address is kept with each vote, only to limit duplicate votes.

empty.title: No fields available yet
empty.body: The Hunt field bank has not been built on this server. Come back later, or explore the presets in the main view.

done.title: You have seen every field
done.body: Thank you. New fields appear when the bank grows.

error.title: Hunt is not available
error.body: The server did not answer. Your votes so far are kept.

rate.title: Slow down for a moment
rate.body: Too many votes in a short time. Wait {{seconds}} seconds and try again.

turnstile.needed: A quick check is required before more votes are accepted. Complete it and vote again.

mover.name: Mover
mover.hint: A source changes position between epochs.

brightness_change.name: Brightness change
brightness_change.hint: A source stays in place but gets brighter or fainter.

artifact.name: Artifact
artifact.hint: Streaks, diffraction spikes, edges, defects, or anything that is not a real source.

nothing.name: Nothing
nothing.hint: Stars stay put; small brightness changes shared by all stars do not count.

streak.title: Streaks and satellites
streak.body: Some pixels of this field carry the STREAK flag: a satellite or another bright track crossed the image. A straight line that appears in one epoch only is an artifact, not a mover. Real movers are compact and shift a little between epochs. An asteroid crosses the field in hours and may appear as faint dots in one epoch only.

mark.hint: Optional: click the image to mark where the change is. Press X to remove the mark.

tools.label: View
tools.diffNeedsTwo: Difference needs at least two epochs.
tools.keys: Left and right arrows step the epochs. Space plays or pauses. B blink, D difference, Z zoom, plus and minus change speed.

gold.title: Check field
gold.right: Correct. Your answer matches the known answer.
gold.wrong: The known answer for this field was: {{answer}}.
gold.why: Check fields have a known answer and help weigh votes. They are mixed in without notice.

counters.title: Community so far
counters.note: Counts are totals only. They never identify a person.

look.title: Look at one field
look.body: Each field shows the same patch of sky as imaged by SPHEREx at different times. The player blinks between epochs. Most stars stay in place. A nearby star can shift by about one pixel; in Difference it shows as a light and dark pair.

controls.title: Use the keyboard
controls.body: Step through the epochs with the arrow keys, or press Space to play. Switch to Difference to see only what changed. Zoom and contrast apply to every epoch equally.

classify.title: Classify what you see
classify.body: Choose one of five answers, or press 1 to 5. Artifact includes satellite streaks and other defects. Nothing and Not sure are valid answers. Optionally click the image to mark the position.

trust.title: What your vote means
trust.body: Some fields have a known answer and are shown to you after you vote. Agreement among volunteers is only a candidate for review. It is never a discovery.

candidates.title: Candidates from volunteers
candidates.note: A candidate is an agreement between volunteers, not a confirmed detection. Each one is a field to review. It means agreement among weighted volunteers, not a statistical detection. A volunteer counts only after answering at least 2 check fields. At most 2 volunteers from the same network address count for each field.
candidates.label: Top answer
